data.name: Dalir
data.gender_notes: Dalir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘d-l-r’, meaning ‘to be just’ and ‘to be fair’. Dalir refers to a righteous and just person in Islam. The name Dalir carries the meaning “The Just” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dalir usually hope their child will grow to embody the just and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the quest for justice and fairness in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Dalir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Just.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dalir total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
